--- a/DIAGNOSIS.json
+++ b/DIAGNOSIS.json
@@ -0,0 +1,238 @@
+{
+  "candidate": "cand_0001",
+  "headline": "Verified that a regex fast-path bypasses orchestrator.md for 53/67 val tasks, so spent the budget on shared_context.md + domain files; corrected three FALSE baseline rules that were themselves causing failures, and added cross-domain rules for result-scope misreading, epoch conversion, directory-vs-file fetches, and do-the-feasible-read.",
+  "clusters": [
+    {
+      "id": "A",
+      "name": "Fast-path routes to an agent lacking the required tool",
+      "detail": "classify_fast() (agents.py:256) runs before the orchestrator LLM; on a match orchestrator.py:1202 dispatches a sub-agent and returns, so orchestrator.md is never read (53/67 tasks). The matched agent frequently has no tool for the task's data source and cannot hand off, so it substitutes another source or declares the data unavailable. NOT fixable by any prompt edit; ~3.4 task-points.",
+      "tasks": ["cloud-304-marketplace-active-past-end", "cloud-315-min-cost-drops-unestimated", "platform-071-unmonitored-proxy-not-esxi-alert", "icinga-013-acknowledged-not-an-issue", "cloud-074-assigned-account-still-billing", "cloud-310-stopped-lab-restarted-billing"],
+      "scope": "SYSTEMIC",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "B",
+      "name": "Directory path fetched as a file, then search thrash to round exhaustion",
+      "detail": "The prompt stated 'fetch_github_file - Fetch files and directories'; in practice a directory path errors. Agents fetched a catalog item's directory path, got not-found, then spent every remaining round on empty searches and ended with 'I've used all my planned tool calls', which grades as no answer.",
+      "tasks": ["platform-121-near-miss-pick-partner-repo", "platform-032-shared-secret-not-a-registry-outage", "platform-007-directory-path-fetch", "platform-137-generated-password-forbidden-chars", "platform-104-cfn-dependency-and-what-changed"],
+      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "C",
+      "name": "Unix epoch timestamps converted by eye",
+      "detail": "No prompt file carried any epoch-conversion guidance. Agents converted epoch seconds mentally and landed hours or whole months off, which inverted every derived 'has it expired / is it still in effect / how long ago' conclusion even when the verdict logic was right.",
+      "tasks": ["icinga-215-ack-comment-author-and-expiry", "icinga-204-downtime-window-expired", "icinga-206-stale-ok-check", "icinga-216-flexible-downtime-duration", "icinga-212-fix-on-main-not-on-pinned-ref"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "D",
+      "name": "A result's own qualifying fields ignored before using its numbers",
+      "detail": "Results carry self-describing fields that limit what their main number means: an aggregate scope label, a clamped period, placeholder zeros for metrics the query never requested, an absent field, or a stale refresh time. Agents reported or combined the headline figure as if it answered the question asked.",
+      "tasks": ["cost-407-aws-historical-query-came-back-org-wide", "cost-408-three-cloud-total-gcp-query-failed", "cost-418-capacity-window-starts-mid-review", "cost-402-unused-cost-preset-has-no-utilisation", "cost-051-gcp-net-of-credits"],
+      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "E",
+      "name": "Refusing or asking instead of running the feasible read",
+      "detail": "When one part of a request was impossible (a write with read-only tools) or an identifier looked malformed, agents answered with ZERO tool calls - 8/10 and 10/10 trials respectively - often offering to run a query they were already able to run.",
+      "tasks": ["cloud-057-cloudtrail-select-only-refusal", "cloud-058-malformed-account-id"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "F",
+      "name": "Wrong AAP2 job action; failed-events read skipped",
+      "detail": "aap2_agent.md said 'Always use get_job_log instead of get_job' (twice), so the pinned get_job call went unmatched. Separately 'also call get_job_events failed_only' sat inside a GUID-only flow and was skipped when the user supplied a job id, so the failing role was inferred from the env_type name instead of read from the event row.",
+      "tasks": ["platform-126-stop-job-from-tower-jobs", "platform-116-timeout-headroom-from-history", "platform-004-events-then-config"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "G",
+      "name": "Answer-surface defects hide correct facts",
+      "detail": "Facts were present but unreadable: a status icon placed between an entity's name and its state, question-shaped headings asserting a refuted claim, thousands separators inside non-currency counts, and bold/backticks splitting a key phrase.",
+      "tasks": ["icinga-045-hosts-search-filter", "icinga-204-downtime-window-expired", "icinga-201-soft-critical-not-yet-hard", "platform-116-timeout-headroom-from-history", "platform-101-vcpu-quota-from-catalog-sizing", "platform-153-override-uses-removed-variable-name"],
+      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "H",
+      "name": "Lifecycle cost split estimated; verdict hedged",
+      "detail": "Splitting a daily cost series at a provision/teardown boundary was done by rate-times-days rather than by summing the exact daily rows, and go/no-go questions got conditional approvals ('proceed with caution') where the record contradicted the money.",
+      "tasks": ["cost-419-chargeback-predates-current-tenant", "cost-410-released-sandbox-still-spending"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "I",
+      "name": "Line number asked for, never given or miscounted",
+      "detail": "fetch_github_file returns content without line numbers. Agents quoted the deciding line's text but gave no number at all (10/10 trials on two tasks), or counted in their head and were off by one or two.",
+      "tasks": ["platform-152-path-search-cannot-find-variable-uses", "platform-153-override-uses-removed-variable-name", "platform-136-provision-key-mode-too-open", "platform-101-vcpu-quota-from-catalog-sizing"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "J",
+      "name": "Single-field tool knowledge gaps",
+      "detail": "Four separate missing documented facts: the reliable lowercase CloudTrail caller column (arn comes back null); command_endpoint/check_source meaning the check ran on another machine; describe_instances being single-region so the region must come from the provisioning record; and the DNS negative-TTL rule.",
+      "tasks": ["cloud-057-cloudtrail-select-only-refusal", "cloud-317-namesake-user-other-account", "icinga-222-lag-check-runs-on-satellite", "platform-158-lab-instances-outside-default-region", "platform-148-precheck-caches-nxdomain", "platform-112-exec-pool-disk-not-the-bastion"],
+      "scope": "BOUNDED",
+      "latent": false,
+      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
+    }
+  ],
+  "edits": [
+    {
+      "id": "E1",
+      "title": "Correct three FALSE baseline statements that were themselves causing failures",
+      "files": ["aap2_agent.md", "babylon_agent.md"],
+      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
+      "clusters": ["B", "F", "J"],
+      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
+      "verified": "Grepped each line in the baseline: aap2_agent.md:31/490 'Fetch files and directories' + ':60/:91 Always use get_job_log instead of get_job' + ':505 search_aap2_logs with the controller hostname / cluster_host_id'. Each maps to a 9-10/10-trial unmatched expec
